description: This file contains unit tests for various TUI (Text User Interface) utility functions and components, including command parsing, session key resolution, agent inference, disconnect reason handling, deduplication logic, Ctrl+C action handling, and safe shutdown procedures.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Resolves the final assistant response text, preferring the 'finalText' if available, falling back to 'streamedText', or error message with HTTP status code.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses slash commands from user input, normalizing aliases and extracting command name and arguments.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of slash commands available in the TUI.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Computes the session key based on raw input, session scope, current agent ID, and main key, applying normalization rules.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Infers the initial TUI agent ID based on configuration, current working directory, and optional session input.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Provides guidance based on disconnect reason, especially for pairing requirements or generic disconnects.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a deduplication function for backspace events within a specified time window.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines whether to clear input, warn, or exit on Ctrl+C based on timing and input state.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks if an error during TUI shutdown is safe to ignore, based on error code and syscall.

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Executes a cleanup function, swallowing ignorable errors during TUI stop processes.

ctags.name: state
ctags.pattern: /^    const state = resolveGatewayDisconnectState("gateway closed (1008): pairing required");$/
